questionsToConsider: Is the survey about one process, or several? Send a separate link per process so answers don't blur together.
Will people answer honestly if their manager can see the results? Decide who reads them and say so up front.
Which fixes in the ranking list are actually in your power to make?
Do you want to hear from people upstream and downstream of the process, not only the ones inside it?
guide.howToUseResponses: Group answers by role: the people doing the work see different problems from the people handing work in or relying on the result. Workarounds are the most useful answers here, because each one marks a gap someone has already solved for themselves and could be made standard. Take the top-ranked fix and the most common time sink, pick one to change first, and tell everyone what you chose and why.
customizeSteps: Put the process name in the greeting, or add it as a hidden field and remove the first question.
Replace the time-sink options and the ranking items with the steps and tools your process really uses.
Share the link with everyone who touches the process, then book walk-throughs with the people who offered.

faqs.q: What is a process improvement survey?
faqs.a: It asks the people who work in a process where time is lost, where mistakes happen and what would help. It is usually the first step before redesigning a workflow.

faqs.q: What questions should I ask to improve a process?
faqs.a: Ask where time goes, what went wrong recently, what workarounds people use and which fixes they would choose. Concrete recent examples are worth more than general ratings.

faqs.q: Should a process improvement survey be anonymous?
faqs.a: Often, yes, especially if the process crosses teams. This template only asks for an email from people who volunteer for a follow-up call.

faqs.q: What do I do after the survey?
faqs.a: Share a summary, pick one change to try first, and check back with the same people a few weeks later to see if it helped.
